units.notes: Mark registry; global state replaced by parser-owned *IDMap.
Value model + byte-exact Dump(). original-oid parsed not re-emitted; gpgsig stripped.
Streaming parser; exact length-prefixed data reads. Round-trip vs real git fast-export/fast-import matches commit count + tree hashes.
Per-commit filter/rename, deleteall preserved, collision dedup, byte-sorted. Unit-tested.
Literal+regex blob rewrite, binary-skip (NUL in first 8KiB). Regex replacement is literal (no backref expansion). Unit-tested.
prune-empty auto/always/never + parent remap via CommitFilter-owned map. Structural emptiness only (no live-tree compare); genuine merges never pruned (no AncestryGraph). Unit-tested.
git subprocess wrappers: layout/is-bare, count-objects, refs, config, remotes.
Fresh-clone (packs<=1 & loose<100) + clean-worktree guard; --force bypass. Niche checks (replace-ref loose, case-fold ref collisions, stash/unpushed/multi-worktree) not ported.

Spawns git fast-export | transform | fast-import + ref update + cleanup; GitBin injected to avoid gitc-shim recursion. End-to-end tests on real git: path purge (fsck clean) + text redaction across all blobs.

excluded: full AncestryGraph is_ancestor (merge parent-trim / degenerate flattening) — minimal parent-remap used instead
content-identical-tree empty detection via live fast-import query (structural emptiness used instead)
FilteringOptions CLI arg parser (gitc supplies opts programmatically / via gitc gitc clean)
niche sanity checks (replace-ref loose objects, case-fold ref collisions, stash/unpushed/multi-worktree)
parity_suite: internal/filterrepo/filterrepo_test.go (fast-export round-trip), transforms_test.go, commitfilter_test.go, pipeline_test.go (end-to-end path removal + text redaction on real git); fixtures referenced from upstream t/t9390 and t/t9391 (CC0)
attribution: Clean-room reimplementation of git-filter-repo (MIT). Reimplemented from format/behavior understanding; no source code copied. GPL2 test harness not ported.
local_modifications: No global mutable state: module globals replaced by parser-owned *IDMap, per-record dump bookkeeping, and a CommitFilter-owned prune remap.
original-oid parsed but not re-emitted (matches upstream Dump).
Regexes use Go RE2: backrefs/lookaround in patterns error at construction; --replace-text regex replacement is literal (no backref expansion); --path-rename regex backrefs \1 translated to ${1}.
Prune emptiness is structural; genuine merges never pruned (no AncestryGraph).
Pipeline threads Options.GitBin so the rewrite execs the resolved real git, never the gitc shim.
